title: (R)POST.------IND.DY.TD.
description: Diagram in WI-28. (R)POST — the reality of postulation — is crossed with INDIV-DY-TD (individual dynamic tendencies). Note the explicit appearance of AFI-1 (affinity insight, first degree — the *affirmation/transformation* principle introduced in T(AF)M-40) as a node, marking that this diagram is structurally about whether the white improvisor's real postulation can reach AFI(1)-grade insight. POST → INFO-OR (information order); AFL (affinity alignment) → INFO-OR; (P)ATTN (the point of activation of attraction) → INFO-OR. INFO-OR is the central hub, fanning to INDIV-DY-TD (the crossing partner) and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). AFL-DY → AFI-1. (P)ATTN also → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). Structural argument: the reality of postulation, affinity alignment, and the point-of-activation of attraction all converge on information order, which produces both individual dynamic tendencies (the crossing partner) and affinity dynamics. Affinity dynamics then produces AFI-1 — the transformation/affirmation principle. The point-of-activation of attraction also produces projectional dynamics directly. The diagram thus diagrams the structural conditions under which the white improvisor's real postulation could reach AFI(1)-grade insight: it requires the convergence of three independent upstreams (real postulation, affinity alignment, point-of-activation attraction) at information order, with affinity-dynamics as the necessary intermediate. The point-of-activation of attraction must be operative — meaning the actual moment of being drawn (not merely intellectually interested) is structurally required. AFI-1 is reachable, but only via this specific chain.
